# apple_cancel_review_submission (Action)

Removes an App Store version's platform from App Review by canceling its open review submission. The version becomes Developer Rejected, can be edited again, and can be submitted again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_cancel_review_submission" "ios" {
  config {
    version_id = apple_app_store_version.ios.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Store version, e.g. `apple_app_store_version.example.id`.
